The solicitation also extends the proposal due date to 5 November 2026 at 4:00 pm Eastern Standard Time. NOTE: On 8 August 2026, Solicitation Amendment 001 was published in the E-TIC portal, including a revised solicitation, a revised Section L, and a Question & Answer set Batch 1. SOLICITATION ANNOUNCEMENT: AN/BYG-1 APPLICATIONS The Department of the Navy, Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA), on behalf of the Portfolio Acquisition Executive for Undersea (PAE Undersea) and the Director, Submarine Programs (DSP), is releasing the formal solicitation for the AN/BYG-1 Applications requirement from the Submarine Combat and Weapons Control Program Office (PMS 425). This notice follows the previously published Draft Request for Proposal (RFP) and Industry Day event. The Government has reviewed the feedback received during and after the Industry Day and has revised the requirements accordingly for this final solicitation. SCOPE OF THE REQUIREMENT (GENERAL OVERVIEW) AN/BYG-1 is the U.S. Navy�s Submarine Combat Control System. The AN/BYG-1 provides tools for the analysis of surface, sub-surface, and airborne contacts operating in the vicinity of own-ship and within the mission theater. This analysis supports command and decision-making, payload and attack control functions, determination of ballistic data for legacy torpedoes, and initiation of firing sequence for all payload types in support of submarine mission areas. The scope of this solicitation encompasses the development, testing, integration, delivery, logistics, and full-lifecycle sustainment of compiled AN/BYG-1 software baselines. This includes current, future, and legacy AN/BYG-1 applications as part of a modernized capability delivery framework. Key objectives and technical efforts under this contract include: Deliver AN/BYG-1 capabilities and baselines in alignment with Submarine Tactical Requirements Group priorities Decouple AN/BYG-1 applications from hardware and software dependencies Implement microcontainer/microservices AN/BYG-1 architecture Transform AN/BYG-1 development and test environments by increasing virtualization and establishing a common, shared infrastructure Develop and integrate tactical decision aids that leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies Assist with the design, development, and integration of combat control system elements to support international cooperative agreements and joint programs. ACCESS TO SOLICITATION DOCUMENTS AND CLASSIFIED DATA The AN/BYG-1 Applications solicitation, Statement of Work (SOW), and associated unclassified attachments are designated as Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and will not be posted directly to SAM.gov. These documents will be made available exclusively via the secure Electronic Technical Information Center (E-TIC) portal hosted by the Advanced Interactive Management Technology Center (AIMTC). Additionally, portions of the Government Furnished Information, specifically, the classified software source code provided to support proposal development are classified at the SECRET level and will be transmitted physically. Documents made available during this procurement may contain classified data and/or technical data whose export is restricted by the Arms Export Control Act. Foreign participation shall be limited by applicable legal authorities, regulations, and other security classification requirements as specified in the DD Form 254. Consolidated Access Request Instructions Prospective Offerors must submit a single, consolidated access request email to the Points of Contact listed below to obtain E-TIC portal access and the classified GFI software package. Email Attachments Required: DD Form 254: A completed copy of the DD Form 254. Block 6 must verify that the requesting company possesses a Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA) issued SECRET facility clearance (FCL) and SECRET safeguarding capability. CRITICAL SECURITY NOTE FOR AWARD ELIGIBILITY: While a SECRET FCL is sufficient for proposal preparation and GFI access, the Offeror must ultimately possess a fully adjudicated TOP SECRET facility clearance and TOP SECRET safeguarding capability, issued by the U.S. Government, no later than contract award. The Government will not sponsor facility clearance upgrades or personnel clearance upgrades for the purpose of proposal submission or contract award eligibility. DD Form 2345: A current, approved copy of the company�s DD Form 2345 (Military Critical Technical Data Agreement). Executed Terms of Use Agreement (TOUA): A signed copy of the TOUA, executed by the Offeror's Facility Security Officer (FSO) or authorized corporate representative. E-TIC Representative: Provide the full name, official company email address, and phone number of the designated individual who will serve as the E-TIC account holder. Classified Media Request (Yes/No): State explicitly whether your company is requesting delivery of the classified software source code. Classified Mailing Info (Required only if requesting Classified Media): Provide the name and contact information of the company's FSO, along with the verified Classified Mailing Address of your facility as registered in the National Industrial Security System (NISS). If your company is NOT requesting the classified source code, please state "Not Applicable" or "N/A" for these fields. Access requires a DoD Common Access Card (CAC) or an approved DoD External Certification Authority (ECA) Certificate, along with an active Joint Certification Program (JCP) registration number. Foreign National: Select "Yes" or "No". Email Address: Official company email only (no Gmail, Yahoo, etc.). Branch or Code: PMS425 Phone Number: Requestor's direct phone number. NUWC Sponsor POC: Eun-Ja O. Please note that you will not be able to access the PMS425 AN/BYG-1 Applications until your account request is approved by the Approval Official and processed. Please allow for processing. SOLICITATION ANNOUNCEMENT: AN/BYG-1 APPLICATIONS The Department of the Navy, Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA), on behalf of the Portfolio Acquisition Executive for Undersea (PAE Undersea) and the Director, Submarine Programs (DSP), is releasing the formal solicitation for the AN/BYG-1 Applications requirement from the Submarine Combat and Weapons Control Program Office (PMS 425). This notice follows the previously published Draft Request for Proposal (RFP) and Industry Day event. The Government has reviewed the feedback received during and after the Industry Day and has revised the requirements accordingly for this final solicitation. SCOPE OF THE REQUIREMENT (GENERAL OVERVIEW) AN/BYG-1 is the U.S. Navy�s Submarine Combat Control System. The AN/BYG-1 provides tools for the analysis of surface, sub-surface, and airborne contacts operating in the vicinity of own-ship and within the mission theater. This analysis supports command and decision-making, payload and attack control functions, determination of ballistic data for legacy torpedoes, and initiation of firing sequence for all payload types in support of submarine mission areas. The scope of this solicitation encompasses the development, testing, integration, delivery, logistics, and full-lifecycle sustainment of compiled AN/BYG-1 software baselines. This includes current, future, and legacy AN/BYG-1 applications as part of a modernized capability delivery framework. Key objectives and technical efforts under this contract include: Deliver AN/BYG-1 capabilities and baselines in alignment with Submarine Tactical Requirements Group priorities Decouple AN/BYG-1 applications from hardware and software dependencies Implement microcontainer/microservices AN/BYG-1 architecture Transform AN/BYG-1 development and test environments by increasing virtualization and establishing a common, shared infrastructure Develop and integrate tactical decision aids that leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies Assist with the design, development, and integration of combat control system elements to support international cooperative agreements and joint programs. title: Armed Forces Recruiting Building 25 Tenant Improvement and Renovation Project- Sources Sought Notice
description: THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION AND SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE for construction services to deliver a turnkey tenant improvement project for the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers at the Denver Federal Center in Lakewood, Colorado. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL. The U.S. General Services Administration (GSA), Public Buildings Service, Acquisition Project Delivery � Capital Construction Division, is conducting market research: to determine if there are sufficient small business, HUBZone small business, Women-Owned small business, or Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned small business contractors capable of performing the construction services for the requirement described herein. If GSA determines that sufficient competition exists, GSA may set the requirement aside for competition among the selected group. GSA is seeking all qualified and interested sources (both large and small businesses) to respond to this Request for Information to provide Construction Services for the turnkey Tenant Improvement space construction project for the Corps of Engineers at the Denver Federal Center in Lakewood, Colorado. The contract type is anticipated to be a firm-fixed-price contract using a design-bid-build delivery approach. Construction activities are expected to occur primarily during normal working hours, with certain utility outage needs to be performed after hours to avoid disrupting active building operations. The tenant build-out is in an existing facility with surrounding active tenants requiring coordination. Work includes demolition, architectural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, telecommunications, audiovisual systems, security, equipment, and furnishings, in full compliance with the GSA 2026 Public Buildings Service Core Building Standards, including all applicable standards, criteria and guides referenced therein, and Military Recruiting Facilities - Construction and Security Specifications. The project consists of approximately 30,464 square feet of combined office, assembly, support, and storage space, including 19,473 square feet of finished office space, 3,058 square feet of finished assembly space, 5,733 square feet of finished storage space, 875 square feet of locker rooms, and 1,039 square feet of mechanical and electrical rooms. The finished spaces will accommodate reception areas, closed and open-plan offices, training rooms, break rooms, security rooms, copy/mail/print rooms, IT storage rooms, shower/locker rooms, server rooms, and general storage. The project also includes integration of existing mechanical and electrical equipment associated with the space�s prior use as an open office environment. Location of performance: Building 25 Denver Federal Center W. 6th Ave. and Kipling St. Lakewood, CO 80225 Any resultant contract shall comply with the 2026 Public Buildings Service Core Buildings Standards and Building Information Modeling (BIM). GSA anticipates award of a contract for these services no later than July 2027. The contract duration is estimated to be ten (10) months. The estimated dollar value of this requirement is between $5,000,000 and $10,000,000. The applicable NAICS code for this requirement is 236220, Commercial and Institutional Building Construction. The Small Business Size Standard is $45M. All interested parties may submit to the GSA Contracting Officer a written Letter of Interest including a Capability Statement addressing the following information (five (5) single-sided page limit in PDF). Additional pages will not be considered. All information submitted is subject to verification. Additional information may be requested to substantiate responses. The Government will use this information to assess your firm�s capability to perform this project. RESPONSE REQUIREMENTS: Respondents shall complete the Google Form: https://forms.gle/1BaouN4uVgC2LTkJ7 and submit a separate Capability Statement attachment demonstrating their firm�s capability to perform the proposed requirement. The Google Form shall be used to collect general company information, business size, socioeconomic status, and other information requested therein. The Capability Statement shall address the requirements outlined below and shall not be submitted through the Google Form. CAPABILITY STATEMENT: Describe the company�s capability to perform a contract of this magnitude and complexity. Provide a brief narrative description of three (3) projects performed as a prime contractor that demonstrate experience relevant to this requirement. Projects shall have been completed within the past seven (7) years. Work performed as a subcontractor will not be considered evidence of capability to succeed as a prime contractor. Relevant projects are those that demonstrate experience with projects of similar size, scope, and complexity. The Government will consider the following characteristics in determining relevance: Contract Value: Construction cost at time of award was at least $4,000,000. Size: Projects with a comparable construction footprint. Scope: Interior construction, renovation, or tenant build-out within an existing and occupied facility, including coordination of multiple trades (mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and low-voltage/security systems). For each project, include the customer name, point of contact, period of performance, contract value, and a brief description of the work performed. RESPONSES TO THIS REQUEST FOR INFORMATION ARE DUE NO LATER THAN November 5, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. Mountain Time. Electronic submission (no more than 25 megabytes of the statement of capabilities package may be submitted to Jamie Potter (GSA Contracting Officer) at jamie.potter@gsa.gov. Please include the subject line: � Armed Forces Recruiting Building 25 Tenant Improvement and Renovation Project Sources Sought Response.� Responses to this Request For Information shall be used for planning purposes only and shall not commit GSA to issue a solicitation(s) for this requirement. The Government is not obligated to and will not pay for any information received from the respondents as a result of this market research. GSA anticipates that a solicitation or solicitations based on the outcome of this market survey will be published and that a subsequent contract or contracts from the solicitation(s) will be awarded. ***END***

description: Description NOTE: On 22 September 2026, Solicitation Amendment 002 was published in the E-TIC portal, including a revised solicitation, a revised Section L and other changes, all of which are identified in the Amendment summary of changes. The solicitation also extends the proposal due date to 5 November 2026 at 4:00 pm Eastern Standard Time. NOTE: On 8 August 2026, Solicitation Amendment 001 was published in the E-TIC portal, including a revised solicitation, a revised Section L, and a Question & Answer set Batch 1. SOLICITATION ANNOUNCEMENT: AN/BYG-1 APPLICATIONS The Department of the Navy, Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA), on behalf of the Portfolio Acquisition Executive for Undersea (PAE Undersea) and the Director, Submarine Programs (DSP), is releasing the formal solicitation for the AN/BYG-1 Applications requirement from the Submarine Combat and Weapons Control Program Office (PMS 425). This notice follows the previously published Draft Request for Proposal (RFP) and Industry Day event. The Government has reviewed the feedback received during and after the Industry Day and has revised the requirements accordingly for this final solicitation. SCOPE OF THE REQUIREMENT (GENERAL OVERVIEW) AN/BYG-1 is the U.S. Navy�s Submarine Combat Control System. The AN/BYG-1 provides tools for the analysis of surface, sub-surface, and airborne contacts operating in the vicinity of own-ship and within the mission theater. This analysis supports command and decision-making, payload and attack control functions, determination of ballistic data for legacy torpedoes, and initiation of firing sequence for all payload types in support of submarine mission areas. The scope of this solicitation encompasses the development, testing, integration, delivery, logistics, and full-lifecycle sustainment of compiled AN/BYG-1 software baselines. This includes current, future, and legacy AN/BYG-1 applications as part of a modernized capability delivery framework. Key objectives and technical efforts under this contract include: Deliver AN/BYG-1 capabilities and baselines in alignment with Submarine Tactical Requirements Group priorities Decouple AN/BYG-1 applications from hardware and software dependencies Implement microcontainer/microservices AN/BYG-1 architecture Transform AN/BYG-1 development and test environments by increasing virtualization and establishing a common, shared infrastructure Develop and integrate tactical decision aids that leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies Assist with the design, development, and integration of combat control system elements to support international cooperative agreements and joint programs. ACCESS TO SOLICITATION DOCUMENTS AND CLASSIFIED DATA The AN/BYG-1 Applications solicitation, Statement of Work (SOW), and associated unclassified attachments are designated as Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and will not be posted directly to SAM.gov. These documents will be made available exclusively via the secure Electronic Technical Information Center (E-TIC) portal hosted by the Advanced Interactive Management Technology Center (AIMTC). Additionally, portions of the Government Furnished Information, specifically, the classified software source code provided to support proposal development are classified at the SECRET level and will be transmitted physically. Documents made available during this procurement may contain classified data and/or technical data whose export is restricted by the Arms Export Control Act. Foreign participation shall be limited by applicable legal authorities, regulations, and other security classification requirements as specified in the DD Form 254. description: This market survey is being conducted to identify potential sources that may be able to provide production kits and installation for the United States Air Force (USAF) MC-130J aircraft platform hereby referred to as MC-130J. This installation, integration, and support of a Line-of-Sight (LOS) Link 16 capability on MC-130J aircraft at multiple Government-designated locations. Sole source to Sierra Nevada Corporation (SNC) is anticipated due to the lack of proprietary data and engineering expertise needed to perform this support effort. SNC is the only known sole qualified source for this requirement. The level of security clearance is secret and no foreign participation is needed for this requirement. The Contractor will be required to furnish all material, support equipment, tools, test equipment, and services. title: Facility Enhancement and Maintenance IDIQ
description: This requirement is for a non-personal services, Indefinite-Delivery, Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract to provide all management, labor, materials, equipment, tools, transportation, and supervision necessary for facility enhancement and maintenance at Joint Base Lindsey Graham, South Carolina, and its associated locations. The requirement includes three primary areas: 1) Floor Covering, which involves the removal and replacement of materials such as carpet, tile, and rubber flooring; 2) Protective Coatings, which includes surface preparation, painting, sealing, and water blasting; and 3) Maintenance and Repairs, covering miscellaneous "like-in-kind" replacement of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems. All work will be performed via individual task orders issued in accordance with the Statement of Work. Submit all questions via email to brandon.rawlings@us.af.mil and bryan.coppage.1@us.af.mil no later than 28 October 2026.

title: 6515 - Intent to Sole Source - Siemens Skyra Coldhead RDE-412L4 (11472997
description: THIS IS A PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE Sole Source The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Regional Procurement Office West (RPOW), Veterans Integrated Service Network (VISN) 5, Health Service Area (HSA) 5.2, Network Contracting Office (NCO) 21, on behalf of VA San Francisco Health Care System (VASFHCS), intends to issue a sole source firm-fixed contract for a potential commercial supply requirement supporting the existing firm-fixed price contract for a Siemens Skyra Coldhead RDE-412L4 at VASFHCS. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this requirement is 339112 - Surgical and Medical Instrument Manufacturing. The Small Business Administration (SBA) size standard is 1000 employees. The Product Service Code (PSC) is 6515 - Medical and Surgical Instruments, Equipment, and Supplies. It is the Government's belief that only the proposed vendor possesses the required capabilities to successfully meet this requirement. The proposed vendor SIEMENS MEDICAL SOLUTIONS USA, INC is the sole manufacturer and distributor of the Siemens Skyra Coldhead RDE-412L4 (11472997). This equipment is very complex and is set to replace the current piece of equipment that is critical to Veteran care. The San Francisco VA Health Care System currently operates a Siemens Skyra MRI and has a requirement to replace the Coldhead. This notice satisfies the requirement at RFO 5.101. Additionally, IAW RFO 5.101 all interested responsible sources may submit a quotation, bid, or proposal, as appropriate, which will be considered by the agency. All interested offers MUST have an active vendor record in SAM.gov, under the identified NAICS code and NOT have any exclusions such as a delinquent federal debt or debarment. If you are interested in the above requirement, please provide supporting evidence in sufficient detail to demonstrate the ability to comply with the above requirement by 11/05/2026 via email to shaun.owen@va.gov and ensure that the subject line includes: RFQ no. 36C26127Q0100. Responses will be considered by the Government; however, a determination by the Government not to complete the proposed acquisition based upon responses of this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Interested firms should submit a concise capability statement that includes: Company name. UEI and CAGE code. Point of contact name, title, email address, and phone number. Business size under NAICS 339112 and Socioeconomic status, if any. Evidence of Siemens Skyra Coldhead RDE-412L4 (11472997) authorization or authorized source of supply. Available contract vehicle information, if applicable. Point of Contact (POC): Contracting Specialist (CS) Shaun Owen Email: shaun.owen@va.gov

title: CH-53 Depot Level Aircraft Modifications
description: Disclaimer THIS SOURCES SOUGHT IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL. IT DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A SOLICITATION AND SHALL NOT BE CONSTRUED AS A COMMITMENT BY THE GOVERNMENT. RESPONSES IN ANY FORM ARE NOT OFFERS AND THE GOVERNMENT IS UNDER NO OBLIGATION TO AWARD A CONTRACT AS A RESULT OF THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. NO FUNDS ARE AVAILABLE TO PAY FOR PREPARATION OF RESPONSES TO THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. ANY INFORMATION SUBMITTED BY RESPONDENTS TO THIS TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION IS STRICTLY VOLUNTARY. Introduction The Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR), in support of PMA-261 Heavy Lift Helicopters Program Office is seeking sources that have the skills, experience and facilities required to successfully provide installation and material support of CH-53E/K Depot Level Aircraft Modifications. Taskings may include conducting Depot Level A-Kit installations, including but not limited to conducting recurring, non-recurring and prototype aircraft modifications in accordance with Engineering Changes to aircraft designated by the H-53 Program Office, PMA-261. All work will be performed at Government owned CONUS and OCONUS locations. THIS SOURCES SOUGHT IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL. It is a market research tool being used to determine potential and eligible businesses capable of providing the services described herein prior to determining the method of acquisition and issuance of a Request for Proposal. The Government is not obligated to and will not pay for any information received from potential sources as a result of this notice. Background PMA-261 is responsible for providing H53 Heavy Lift aircraft that are capable, reliable and supportable to the fleet in support of operational missions and objectives. A primary element in meeting this responsibility is by integrating the CH-53E/K aircraft with up-to-date warfighting capabilities, safety enhancements and reliability improvements through Depot Level aircraft modifications. Anticipated Period of Performance The contract is intended to satisfy Government requirements for FY27 through FY32. Anticipated Contract Type The contract type is anticipated to be a stand-alone Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) utilizing Cost-Plus Fixed Fee, Cost Reimbursement, and Firm-Fixed pricing arrangements. Required Capabilities The specific requirement of the effort under this sources sought notice is to provide highly capable and experienced Depot Level artisans to inspect, disassemble, modify, assemble, perform post-inspection, operational checks (if required) and document aircraft modifications of CH-53E/K aircraft in accordance with applicable Technical Directives. Primary sites for aircraft modifications will be MCAS Miramar and MCAS New River but will also occasionally require modifications at Government-owned OCONUS locations. Also, the ability to produce and deliver aircraft retrofit A-Kits to support the fielding of aircraft modifications. The tasking includes maintenance and supply support in compliance with CNAFINST 4790.2 series, DCMA 8210 and H-53 Maintenance Instruction Manual procedures with management and performance of the following services: Incorporate aircraft modifications Produce and deliver aircraft retrofit A-Kits Organization Level maintenance (Scheduled and Unscheduled) Prospective offerors MUST: Be able to stand-up aircraft modification capabilities to support aircraft inductions to provide the above support within thirty (30) days after contract award. Eligibility The applicable NAICS code is 336411 with a Small Business Size standard of 1,500 employees. The Product Service Code (PSC) is K015. Businesses of all sizes are encouraged to respond; however, each respondent must clearly identify their business size. Incumbent This is a follow-on requirement. The incumbent contractor is Adams Communication & Engineering Technology Inc. Submission Details All responsible sources are encouraged to submit a capability statement that addresses their ability to perform the full range of services described above at the Platform level at their own organic facilities and other locations. It is requested that interested businesses submit to the contracting office a brief capabilities statement package, in accordance with the directions provided below, (no more than 10 pages in length, single-spaced, 12 point font minimum) demonstrating ability to perform the service listed under the required capabilities. This documentation must address at a minimum the following: Company Name; Company Address; Company Business Size, and Point-of Contact (POC) name, phone number, fax number, and e-mail address. Company profile to include number of employees, annual revenue history from the last five years, office location(s), UEI number, and a statement regarding current small/large business status; Prior/current corporate experience performing efforts of similar size and scope within the last five years, including contract numbers, contract values, Government point of contract with current telephone number, and a brief description of how the referenced contract related to the services described herein; Answers to the following questions, providing details, including contract numbers and any government POCs to demonstrate the experience claimed: Describe your experience (in the last 5 years) in providing rotary wing aircraft Depot Level Modifications. Describe your experience with maintaining aircraft in accordance with the COMNAVAIRFORINST 4790.2 Series. Describe and quantify your ability to meet the required timeline from Task Order/Contract Award to aircraft induction for a CH-53E/K aircraft level modification event. List any external dependencies or GFE requirements to meet that timeline. Describe your experience/capabilities in performing maintenance and modification work concurrently on C/MH-53E series aircraft or similar airframes. Describe your production experience/capabilities, engineering capabilities and internal processes in producing and delivering aircraft retrofit A-Kits CH-53E/K series aircraft or similar airframes. List any industry certifications of your processes. Describe your capability or existing agreements for access to technical data to include engineering/repair data for CH-53E/K aircraft and components. Your response to this Sources Sought, including any capabilities statement, shall be electronically submitted via email to Jamie Schoemaker at Jamie.L.Schoemaker.civ@us.navy.mil, in either Microsoft Word or Portable Document Format (PDF). The deadline for response to this request is 5:00 p.m., Eastern Standard Time, 5 November 2026. All data received in response to this Sources Sought that is marked or designated as corporate or proprietary will be protected from any release outside the Government. Information and materials submitted in response to this request WILL NOT be returned. Classified material SHALL NOT be submitted. No phone calls will be accepted. All questions must be submitted via email. The Government is not committed nor obligated to pay for the information provided, and no basis for claims against the Government shall arise as a result of a response to these Sources Sought. Contact Information Primary Point of Contact: Jamie Schoemaker Procuring Contract Officer jamie.l.schoemaker.civ@us.navy.mil Secondary Point of Contact: Charles Johnson Contracting Specialist charles.w.johnson6.civ@us.navy.mil Contracting Office Address: Building 2272, Room 155 47123 Buse Road Unit IPT Patuxent River, MD 20670 United States

All prospective contractors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM.Gov) database to be awarded a DOD contract. The product service code for this is 4520 - Space and Water Heating Equipment and the NAICS for this action is 333414 - Heating Equipment (except Warm Air Furnaces). This is a one time, brand name purchase for two (2) boilers, please see the attachments for detailed characteristics and specific documentation.
